setups.description: Price swings down into a swing low, then displaces upward aggressively. Anchor from high wick of the down leg to low wick. Project -2/-2.5/-4 levels above.
Price pushes up into a spike high (the manipulation), then displaces downward aggressively. Anchor from low wick of the up leg to high wick. Project -2/-2.5/-4 levels below.

notes: Both are textbook manipulation legs that are obvious to a skilled trader. The indicator's detection criteria are too strict to catch either one. Visible price range: ~29502 to ~29601. Both setups occurred within the same session.
